name: botpress-adk-community
description: Community-maintained Botpress ADK skills for OpenAI Codex. Community-maintained by mazemax; not endorsed by Botpress.

interface.longDescription: Build, debug, evaluate, document, and connect Botpress ADK bots with the official Botpress ADK skills. Community-maintained by mazemax; not endorsed by Botpress. Review side effects before workspace changes or deployment.
defaultPrompt: In this disposable directory, initialize a Botpress ADK project with me and explain account-affecting steps before running them.
Investigate this sanitized ADK failure using checks, logs, and traces, then propose a targeted fix without deploying.
Write an official ADK regression eval for this synthetic order-lookup scenario and explain its assertions.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0-rc.1: initial release candidate with six official Botpress ADK skills from botpress/skills v2.0.7 at 79abe10503bf6dc70486737c94159322e108e496, community packaging, curated prompts, and a reproducible skills-only distribution. Real-host behavior and public-directory approval remain unverified.
